events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with interactive installations, games and cat-focused photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples; games offer chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: Free treats and merchandise/prizes are while supplies last. Official sources advertise visitors can stop by and do not publish an advance RSVP requirement; normal capacity rules can still apply.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 17–19 from 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. Physical pop-up is separate from the nationwide virtual Cat Bodega running through Sept. 26.
